title: How to Animate ANYTHING in Blender!
about: What Lucius kept from this tutorial: one recipe per chapter, each continuing from the scene of the one before. Replay with `lucius teach course courses/JQT9sT1YuAI` (no API needed).

lessons.title: How to keyframe in Blender
lessons.note: Keyed the tutor's way: I on frame 1 (location + rotation), auto-key style rotation only on 30 (so it drifts from frame 1), move + turn on 60, then the fixing location key on 30. The renders show turn-in-place then move.

lessons.title: Graph Editor
lessons.note: Old keys cleared, X keyed 0 at frame 1 and 25 at frame 40: the default ease gives X = 3.38 at frame 10, matching the tutor's reading of ~3.5; a Vector handle on the return key makes it linear. Graph-editor navigation itself changes nothing in the scene.

lessons.title: The Bouncing Ball!
lessons.note: The tutor's method: X at full speed from frame 1 (Vector) easing out; Z bounces 60% as high each time, parabolic, Vector at every contact; spin = distance/radius (1547 deg); an empty at the ball's bottom (parent) carries position and squash (1.22,1.22,0.67 on landings) while the child ball only spins. Checked frame by frame: bottom stays on the floor while squashed.
